title: IMO gold-medal performance
before: Models solved competition problems only with formal tools or heavy scaffolding.
problem: Olympiad problems need original proofs written in natural language under time limits.
breakthrough: Two labs independently scored 35 of 42, solving five of six problems, in natural language. DeepMind's run was certified by IMO coordinators.
why: A milestone for mathematical reasoning, though later independent evaluation found much weaker performance on unfamiliar problems.
next: IMO-ProofBench and other independent evaluations testing generalisation.
inherits: Both the achievement and the caution about what benchmark scores mean.
